verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents a FOCUS API, currently in Public Preview, for exporting usage programmatically. It also offers billing insights that break down consumption by resource type, plus a Managed Grafana Cost and Usage view. Nothing shows spend can be attributed by team, workload, label, or project, and the API's preview status limits confidence in its depth. Missing for 10: per-team or per-workload cost allocation (e.g., label- or tag-based attribution), a generally available billing API, documentation of the FOCUS API's fields and granularity, and independent hands-on corroboration.
